index.name: Agentic Reasoning
index.prereq_pref_index: Large Language Models or Large Deep Learning Systems

header.name: Agentic Reasoning
counting_notes: CSE+Artificial Intelligence, CSE+Data Engineering, ECE+Machine Learning
header.description: The artificial intelligence algorithms known as agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have become popular tools for automated planning and execution of problem solving. With advancements of LLM techniques, specifically reasoning, LLM agents are showing promises to transform the scientific, algorithmic and mathematical discoveries. This course will introduce fundamental concepts of reasoning by LLM agents. It will then discuss the protocols and infrastructures for agent development. The course will cover representative agent applications, such as automated coding. The focus of the course will be on agentic reasoning for algorithmic and mathematical problem solving.

prerequisites.raw: Large Language Models or Large Deep Learning Systems

cos.label: CO1
cos.text: To get familiar with the concept of an AI agent, the Agentic Protocols, such as MCP, A2A, etc.

cos.label: CO2
cos.text: To distingush between generic LLM applications and LLM-enabled agentic Reasoning. To hypothesize the applications and justify a design diagram for infrastructure and implementation of reasoning agents.

cos.label: CO3
cos.text: To design, plan, implement, and deploy LLM Agents for automating the workflow of algorithmic, mathematical, coding, and scientific problems solving.

lecture_weeks.topic_raw: Introduction to the concept of Agentic Reasoning

Agentic Applications Overview; Project Discussion
Agentic Reasoning for Algorithmic and Mathematical Problems
Agents for Coding and Software Development
